_comment: Single source of truth for dynamic memes. Read by generator/build.py (pages), assets/js/meme-render.js (canvas rendering + limits) and smm/posting pipeline/src/meme_links.py (signing + LLM hints). Slot boxes are fractions of the image. max_chars is enforced by both signer and renderer; the renderer also shrinks the font so text fits max_lines inside the box, and refuses to draw if it cannot.

memes.title: This is fine
memes.use_when: Everything is obviously on fire but someone calmly insists all is okay: denial, ignoring an obvious problem, pretending things are normal.

slots.name: top
slots.hint: the situation, e.g. 'ME READING NEWS THAT IS A YEAR OLD'

memes.title: Roll Safe (think about it)
memes.use_when: A 'genius' loophole or cheeky flawed logic, tapping the temple: 'you can't X if you don't Y'.

slots.name: bottom
slots.hint: cheeky logic, e.g. 'IF YOU READ IT A YEAR LATER'

memes.title: Distracted boyfriend
memes.use_when: Someone is tempted away from what they have by something new and shiny: switching preferences, new trend vs. old habit.

slots.name: new_thing
slots.hint: the tempting new thing (woman in red, left)
